title: Hybrid Spark: Adaptive Speculative Decoding That Lets the Content Choose the Drafter
abstract: arXiv:2611.05611v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Speculative decoding (SD) speeds up large language model (LLM) serving, but its gain depends on the workload's \emph{shape}, such as batch size and context length, and on its \emph{content}. A model-based drafter proposes a short block on any content, while a model-free drafter such as n-gram lookup proposes long copies at almost no cost when the output repeats its input, as in code editing. Adaptive verification spends a batch-wide verification budget on the draft tokens most likely to be accepted, but it supports only one model-based drafter. Model-free drafters provide no per-token confidence, so they cannot take part in budget allocation, and deployments must either fix one drafter or split their GPUs between drafters. translated_title: Hybrid Spark：让内容来选择起草者的自适应投机解码
translated_abstract: 投机解码（Speculative Decoding, SD）可以加速大语言模型（LLM）的服务，但其收益取决于工作负载的“形状”（如批次大小和上下文长度）以及其“内容”。基于模型的起草者（drafter）可以在任何内容上提出较短的草拟块，而无模型的起草者（如 n-gram 查找）在输出重复其输入时（如代码编辑场景），几乎零成本地提出较长的复制内容。自适应验证将整个批次的验证预算分配给最可能被接受的草拟词元，但它仅支持单个基于模型的起草者。无模型起草者无法提供逐词元的置信度，因此无法参与预算分配，部署时要么固定使用一个起草者，要么在多个起草者之间分割 GPU 资源。我们提出了 Hybrid Spark，这是一个在每个步骤同时运行一个基于模型的起草者和一个无模型起草者的框架，并为每个请求提供两者中更优的草拟链，整个过程在自适应验证框架内并完全在 GPU 上运行，从而保持异步性……
tldr: Hybrid Spark 提出在每一步同时运行基于模型和无模型两种起草者，并自适应地为每个请求选择更优的草拟链，解决了单一起草者无法适应不同内容类型、无模型起草者无法参与预算分配的问题。
en_tdlr: Hybrid Spark runs both a model-based and a model-free drafter at every step and adaptively gives each request the better of their draft chains within adaptive verification, entirely on GPU.
